narrative: The smuggler's pass is narrow and reeking of old smoke. Someone left a cache of rations hidden in a crevice — payment for silence, perhaps.
The caves swallow sound. Halfway through, you stumble on a shrine to a forgotten road-god. You leave an offering and feel oddly steadier.
The moat tunnel drips with cold water. Bandits had the same idea — you slip past their sleeping sentry with your heart in your throat.
The hidden forest path is overgrown but passable. Birds scatter as you pass — a good omen, your companions say.
The smuggler's pass lives up to its name. Fresh wagon tracks suggest you are not the only ones in a hurry.
The shadowy caves echo with distant dripping. Something glints in the mud — a lucky coin, dropped by a prior traveler.
The castle moat tunnel smells of rust and rot. You emerge shaken but unscathed.
